audit.back_translation: This is a simplified estimate, not an award or promise of payment. It uses the official 2025/2026 PIA formula and assumes a full retirement age of 67. Check your official Social Security statement and use the SSA estimator for a personal estimate. This tool provides general information, not financial advice.
